label: Hammer
note: Endgame hammer sets stack Sharpness +1 with Earplugs/HGE, then add Attack Up (L) or, for negative-affinity hammers, Reckless Abandon (Crit Eye); Rath Soul Z/Diablos Z mixes are common. Focus is optional, KO comes only from the Felyne kitchen in MHFU, and Crit Draw is not a hammer staple.
